title: LeadBalkans 2026 Annual Advocacy Platform
summary: Three days of plenaries, panels and workshops for civil society leaders across the Western Balkans.
description:
LeadBalkans is the Western Balkans Fund's annual advocacy platform.

Now in its fourth edition, three days of plenaries, panels and practitioner workshops bring together over 300 civil society leaders from across the region.
